svg.aria-label: Fibey hosted system architecture: UI, gateway, agent, Toolbox, operational tools, skills, and separate status dashboard

g.text: Hosted deployment: five Container Apps, one Foundry-hosted agent
No browser automation tool is registered by the publisher; additional Toolbox configuration is required.
Local development: the gateway runs the agent in-process; the Toolbox tools and skill-resource path stay the same.
skills/<name>/SKILL.md -> postdeploy REST publisher -> versioned Foundry skills -> Toolbox references
